The four-carbon chain in `butane.cdxml` is an original Bondline fixture, dual-licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0. It puts the middle bond first, uses nonsequential object IDs, omits three H counts and includes an unused Unicode font name. Its atom and bond fields follow the public [CDXML chemistry contract](../../../../../docs/research/cdxml-carbon-analysis.md). The independently pinned RDKit chain remains in the external corpus under its BSD-3-Clause notice.
